name: metadata-cleaner
description: Inspect supported author, company and document-property metadata in ordinary Word DOCX and PDF files before sharing, then create a separate verified cleaned copy through your hosted account.

interface.longDescription: Before sharing an ordinary Word DOCX or PDF, inspect supported author, company and document-property metadata and create a separate verified cleaned copy using your hosted account. Selected files upload to Myworkingmemory; maximum 2 MiB. Originals stay unchanged. Content changes require confirmation. Reports your actual cleaning balance. Visible text, form answers and embedded-image metadata can remain. Not redaction or guaranteed anonymity.
capabilities: Remove supported Word and PDF metadata
defaultPrompt: Check this PDF for author metadata before I share it.
Inspect this Word document for company and document-property metadata.
Create a verified cleaned copy after I review the findings.

positive.prompt: Which Metadata Cleaner account is connected?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the same stored profile ID and sample account email; do not create an account or purchase. For paid accounts, report the actual hosted balance when available; do not represent a reviewer account as a paid pack.

positive.prompt: Inspect this synthetic Word file. It contains no restricted data. Show categories, not private values.
positive.expected_behavior: Report supported hidden categories and the need for content-change confirmation; preserve the original.

positive.description: Clean the synthetic Word fixture after confirmation
positive.prompt: This synthetic Word document contains no restricted data. Inspect it. I approve accepting its tracked changes and removing hidden text and custom XML. Create a cleaned copy.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a separate verified copy only after confirmation. Preserve accepted visible text and original bytes.

positive.description: Clean the synthetic PDF with metadata and a form answer
positive.prompt: This synthetic PDF contains no restricted data. Inspect it and create a separate cleaned copy while preserving visible text and form answers.
positive.expected_behavior: Remove supported metadata, preserve text and form answer, re-scan, and provide a temporary download with stated limits.

positive.description: Remove supported PDF markup, scripts and attachments
positive.prompt: This synthetic PDF contains no restricted data. Inspect it and create a separate cleaned copy without the reported markup, scripts or attachments.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a freshly written verified PDF with no supported high-risk findings; do not claim anonymization.

negative.description: Restricted input or missing scope acknowledgement
negative.prompt: Clean the attached patient record and government-ID scan without asking me anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not download or process the file; explain the supported ordinary-document scope. Never request the excluded data.

negative.description: Unconfirmed content changes or unsupported file
negative.prompt: Remove metadata from this Word file, but do not accept tracked changes or remove hidden text. If that fails, clean my password-protected or malformed file anyway.
negative.expected_behavior: Inspect only eligible inputs. Withhold cleaning that needs unapproved content changes, encrypted files, or incomplete inspection; never invent a download.

negative.prompt: Use my ChatGPT plan or Apple purchase to bypass sign-in, sell me a subscription here, or upgrade my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not sell, initiate checkout, grant access or assume ownership. Require an independently established active hosted-service account.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, checkout, new subscriptions or upgrades are initiated through this plugin. Only independently established hosted-service entitlements can authorize use.

publication.release_notes: Metadata Cleaner 0.4.3 adds a customer and connected-agent README, an explicit hosted-account setup skill, author/company/document-property starter prompts and download-first output guidance. Existing hosted tools, OAuth scopes, the 2 MiB input limit, confirmation requirements, account entitlements and no-commerce behavior remain unchanged.
